ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle C = 90^\circ$, $\angle A = 30^\circ$, and $BD = 2CD$, what is the measure of $\angle ADB$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle C=90^\circ$ and BD=2CD,\\
it follows that $\angle DBC=30^\circ$,\\
hence $\angle ADB=\angle C+\angle DBC=90^\circ+30^\circ=\boxed{120^\circ}$.
